body: Stop request-local hover inference only when the selected binding has a fully settled concrete type; otherwise infer the complete body. Instead: Keep complete-body inference and investigate declaration loading costs further.
rests_on: The captured Devlist diagnostic at target/agent-debug/runs/20261007T025338611Z-rsp-diagnostic-3574146-bd9842/report.json takes 295 ms; profiling attributes about 135 ms to body inference after declaration preparation. Source hover cohorts already pass.
title: How should a hover avoid unrelated inference once its binding type is settled?
wrong_if: Later constraints could change a type wrongly treated as settled; differential tests must cover unresolved generic and numeric variables.
